h: FG reportedly secures 653 convictions in latest Abuja mass terrorism trial
p: The Federal Government has reportedly secured convictions of 653 people in a mass terrorism trial in Abuja. The figure is said to come from the latest phase of a series of trials that began earlier this year, and it has not yet been independently confirmed.
more: Earlier phases of the trials reported hundreds of convictions, with sentences said to range from several years to life.
The Attorney General has led the prosecutions.
